messages:
Emma (Partnerships): quick sync — launching marketplace listing kickoff for AWS/GCP/Azure. Need to lock IAM roles, pricing SKU mapping, trial seat allocation, and legal T&Cs. i'll put the initial doc in the thread shortly.

James (Legal): noted. i'll review the publisher agreement clause re: data processing + DPA. what's the timeline for sign-off?

Emma (Partnerships): target is next Tuesday. would like legal sign-off by Fri COB. @Marta can you confirm packaging (trial vs paid) and SKU naming conventions?

Marta (Product): yes. proposed SKUs: `redwood-inference-core` (monthly per-seat), `redwood-dedicated-reserved` (reserved GPU / fixed commit). trial_flow: 14d demo with usage cap and optional seat add-on. i'll drop a table in the doc with pricing tiers.

Sanjay (Cloud Ops): for AWS/GCP we'll need two service accounts + a cross-account marketplace role. rough IAM snippet below for AWS trust role: 
```
aws iam create-role --role-name RedwoodMarketplacePublisherRole \
  --assume-role-policy-document file://trust.json
```
I'll produce a cloud-specific checklist (role ARNs, minimal policies, terraform snippets).

Ryan (DevRel): devrel will prep quickstart + terraform example for publisher portal. can we get staging creds and a demo tenant? @Ops

Ops (Provisioning): deploy-bot created ticket #MKT-4521 for staging creds and demo tenant. assigning to @Sanjay — ETA 2 business days.

Sanjay (Cloud Ops): got the ticket. adding required role names, ARNs, and recommended policies into the doc. will include example GCP service account JSON and a minimal permissions list.

James (Legal): quick q — do we need region-specific EULAs for Azure marketplace? cc @Marta

Marta (Product): for EU listings we do need an EEA addendum and explicit data residency notes. i'll draft a short DPA + EULAs variant and attach.

Emma (Partnerships): action items summary:
- @James (Legal): review publisher agreement + DPA and flag any blocking clauses (due Fri COB)
- @Marta (Product): finalize SKU names, pricing tiers, trial flow, and EULA variants (due Wed)
- @Sanjay (Cloud Ops): IAM roles + cloud checklist + staging provisioning (due Thu)
- @Ryan (DevRel): quickstart + terraform example + demo tenant walkthrough (due next Mon)
- @Ops (Provisioning): provisioning ticket + staging creds (in progress)

Ryan (DevRel): one more item — telemetry opt-in for trial tenants. we want to surface usage metrics but must respect privacy regs. thoughts?

Marta (Product): product decision: telemetry opt-in default off, with an optional prompt during onboarding. we'll document what metrics we collect.

Emma (Partnerships): perfect. i'll consolidate and send a calendar invite for Fri 10am PT review. sharing the doc now: https://intra.redwood/marketplace/onboard/seedpack (edit access granted to this thread). :rocket:

Emma (Partnerships) (updated): added a short checklist table and a link to the terraform example in the doc. please comment directly on lines you want changed.
